data.name: Search.Page.Intro
data.value: The search index holds the searchable fields of the site's entries and follows every change of them. Rebuild it for content that was there before the plugin, or after the plugin was disabled in the site for a while. A rebuild runs as a job in the background and writes only what differs.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.TypesFailed
data.value: The content types could not be read; the rebuild covers every type.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.TypeHelp
data.value: The types with a searchable field. Without one, every such type is rebuilt.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.StartedEvery
data.value: The rebuild of every searchable type has started.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.StartedEveryNoJobs
data.value: The rebuild of every searchable type has started. It runs in the background, and search answers from the index as it is until it ends.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.StartedNoJobs
data.value: The rebuild of {0} has started. It runs in the background, and search answers from the index as it is until it ends.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.FollowJob
data.value: Follow the job of the rebuild

data.name: Search.Rebuild.Forbidden
data.value: Not started: you may not rebuild the index of this site.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.NotSearchable
data.value: Not started: {0} has no searchable field, so it has nothing to index.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.NotAType
data.value: Not started: {0} is no longer a content type.

data.name: Search.Rebuild.Failed
